Subject: Re: Jordan Liu (SRE Lead) — proposed on-site day + rehearsal

Thanks, Ben and Samira. Rehearsal time works for me — I'll join from a home setup. A couple of small requests:
- Please enable live captions for all panel sessions and the system design exercise. Zoom captions are fine.
- Could you send the run-of-show as a plain-text/HTML file (not just PDF)? My screen reader prefers text.
- For the design exercise, the extra 10 minutes is appreciated; also I use a keyboard-only navigation for demos — if interviewers need me to share a slide deck, let me know in advance so I can prepare an accessible version.

Appreciate it — looking forward to the rehearsal.

Jordan
